Chapter 340: Starting The Journey Home

"Ding! Some system restrictions are lifted!"

"Open the channel between the system-affiliated world and the universe!"

"It is detected that this world cannot bear the opening of the channel. Please leave this world and open the channel again!"

The system prompt sound that Wu Qing expected sounded again!

This time it is no longer a choice of interstellar race, but a direct opening of the channel between the system-affiliated world where Wu Qing was originally located and the universe world!

In the system-affiliated world, there are people Wu Qing cares about, countless powerful people, and invincible armies!

In the system-affiliated world, human technology has been upgraded from the Empire Age and Red Alert to StarCraft, and has a human interstellar base.

In the system-affiliated world, any level 12 emperor-level powerhouse can sweep this world!

Those mysterious evil gods in the outside world are estimated to be unable to beat even the emperor-level primary powerhouses in the system-affiliated world!

Wu Qing didn't know what the system-affiliated world had developed into now, but with the support of the system-affiliated world, he had the confidence to break out of this world!

Coupled with the clues Wu Qing obtained from the native human race about the planet where he was born, he can't wait to step out of this world and open the system-affiliated world!

Wu Qing wants to lead the Zerg, Protoss, Humans and his former subordinates and friends to travel through the outside world to find his hometown!

He really wants to see how powerful the outside world that the spirit god said is!

And what forces do the spirit god and those evil gods belong to, and what is the relationship between the power behind them and the external force in the system-affiliated world!

The rules and will of this world have been beaten to sleep, and this world has become Wu Qing's private property, and everything is at his disposal!

Wu Qing first suspended all wars. He and the Queen of the Insects summoned the strong men of the Protoss to try to find a way to rescue the believers in the evil god camp.

After continuous experiments, they finally succeeded in rescuing the believers who were forced to believe by the evil god with evil magic!

Millions of powerful Zerg and Protoss warriors were dispatched to rescue all the evil god believers and completely cut off the connection between the foreign evil god and this world.

This move greatly stabilized this already very fragile world.

Wu Qing then broke all the interlayer spaces of this world and reintegrated into this world, allowing this world to regain its vitality!

The will of the world rules that was born after the cruel struggle just wanted to take advantage of the situation to wake up, but was inexplicably restricted by the system and fell into an eternal sleep.

In the moment of crisis in the world, the world will with a strong desire to survive will be born. Now that the world is in Wu Qing's hands and has the intervention of the system, this kind of world will is no longer needed.

All the response rules created by the world will to deal with the crisis have collapsed, and this world has returned to the complete world rule state derived from the laws of the universe.

The lordship of this world has all disappeared, and the status of the race's big clan and super clan has disappeared!

All life in this world is treated equally by the world rules, and no one has any privileges.

The world that has been basically stable still cannot open the channel to the system's affiliated world.

Wu Qing's measures can stabilize the world, but they are not enough to restore the loss of the world's origin. The loss of the world's origin will take a long time to recover.

Or this world can plunder the world's origin from the outside world to make up for the loss, so that this originally powerful world can be quickly restored.

Wu Qing plans to leave some Zerg and Protoss in this world, continue to deal with those foreign forces that are spying on this world, and lure those foreign forces to invest their strength to develop and grow, and quickly restore this world.

Wu Qing regards this world as his base camp in this big universe world, and must plan carefully and not allow mistakes.

The Queen of Zerg and the Archon of the Protoss are responsible for a large number of specific matters and make careful arrangements for the development of this world.

He himself is collecting various information about the entire world to prepare for leaving this world.

...

Wu Qing has not contacted many people in this world. The Zerg has developed rapidly. It took a very short time to develop from scratch to the current level.

This speed is so fast that Wu Qing has no chance to interact with the people in this world, and this strange journey is about to end.

Wu Qing's strength has recovered to the current level, and no one in this world can be on par with him.

Wu Qing took some time to gather the limited number of people he knew in the early days of his advent. Except for Meng from the tiger tribe, who could still chat with him, the others basically did not dare to talk casually.

Hu Tu, Meng, Hu Wei, Shi Gan, Yu Chong, Bai Yan, Wu Cong, Gong Zhe, and Naga, only these nine people came, and Wu Qing did not invite the others.

After a brief reminiscence, Wu Qing personally raised the strength of the nine people to the great power level.

Daxia Territory and the Alliance, as Wu Qing's direct forces, will occupy an important position in the development plan of this world.

The goblins and the Naga tribe will be ahead of other races in this new world where the rules of this world have changed.

Wu Qing's departure this time is not to never come back. He wants to use this world as a base to explore the universe, which is much less risky.

After everything was arranged, Wu Qing began to discuss the lineup for the first expedition with the Zerg and the Archon.

They finally decided to concentrate resources and upgrade a Protoss transport spacecraft to twelve stars!

Wu Qing will take this twelve-star powerful Protoss transport spaceship as his vehicle, step out of this world, and embark on a journey to find his hometown!

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading!

The twelve-star Protoss transport spaceship is already a huge spaceship that can carry a large number of Zerg and Protoss arms and supplies. If necessary, you can open the portal at any time to summon a powerful Zerg and Protoss army!

You can also occupy other worlds, quickly build bases, and obtain resources to accelerate development!

In addition, when he arrives in the outside world, Wu Qing will have a system-affiliated world that he can carry with him. Wherever Wu Qing goes, he can project all his power there!

Wu Qing is about to go to the outside world where the evil gods are with a mysterious system, a powerful portable world, and the three interstellar races of the human race, the Zerg race, and the Protoss. He will definitely bring a huge surprise to those guys who hide behind the various worlds to make trouble!

The huge Protoss transport spaceship that covers the sky, with a golden hull, exudes a charming light under the shining of the new sunrise in this world!

The inside of the transport spaceship is a small world with everything. Wu Qing's body came out of the Zerg base camp, stepped into the air, and stepped into the spaceship in a few steps.

Wu Qing's Zerg clone stayed in this world, usually controlled by the Queen of Zerg, and his consciousness could be projected when needed.

The Queen of Zerg is the collective consciousness of the Zerg race. Wherever there are Zerg, there is its existence. It is the most appropriate choice to let it lead this world.

Everything is ready, and a huge portal appears in the sky. This is a portal to the outside world opened by the technology of the Protoss!

The huge golden Protoss transport spaceship started, drilled into the portal, and disappeared!

The huge portal in the sky disappeared quickly!

...

It took Wu Qing only a very short time from coming to this world to leaving. He will always remember this short experience!

Wu Qing's new journey has begun!
